mechanism: Primidone is a prodrug metabolized to phenobarbital, which induces CYP450 enzymes and may reduce beta-lactam antibiotic levels; additionally, antibiotics can alter gut flora affecting primidone enterohepatic recirculation.
action: Monitor clinical response to infection; primidone levels may require monitoring as antibiotics can increase primidone bioavailability through microbiota disruption; ensure seizure control is maintained.
